# Workhorse Group Sets Date for Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 15, 2026 • 9:00 AM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4b1eacf3340f4a997383e33af5a6b092/workhorse/news/2026-10-15_Workhorse_Group_Sets_Date_for_Third_Quarter_340.pdf)


### Conference call scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time


DETROIT, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Workhorse Group Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Wg-7LHsNDcALDHc_YS__WW48fR0o7lWggY5E6rAjMcg73MeAvEMGrvRxEB-9HqgnlBhq0BFJ6zjYflVKCwwU6qfF6uqaDGFN9vwTJql79yI=) (NASDAQ: WKHS) (“Workhorse”), an American Industrial Technology company, plans to conduct a conference call to discuss its third quarter results and business outlook on **Thursday, November 12, 2026** , at **4:30 p.m. Eastern time** .


Prior to the conference call, Workhorse will issue its third quarter earnings press release. The press release may also be viewed on Workhorse’s website at[ir.workhorse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PQKo1Xr6tpdjBhFe1ZJQr0IbYQzahv9oaoq59ICgxZakVVwN7_w5yw4JersHqVeV9gjhdxn1uOad7aEqMCc_PJQGc6eVi9n2yQXSUw8H1aQ=) .


To listen to the conference call webcast, please go to the[Investor Relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NsoCv0HyCUeRQZ8bjOo-NF57u2gPB45vDVuq4W9O0qqYsnHzk-ygPe5EGf-H3k6JSl9gFQp2JXciJSJoOgbqR1d9_cPqCp3Y6k20LVcB5cU=) section of Workhorse’s website.


To listen via telephone, please call (877)-407-0789 (U.S.) or (201)-689-8562 (international). A telephonic replay of the conference call will be available after 9:00 p.m. Eastern time on the same day through November 26, 2026.


Toll-free replay number: (844)-512-2921


International replay number: (412)-317-6671


Replay ID: 13762979


**About Workhorse Group Inc.**


Headquartered in the Detroit area with a commercial-scale manufacturing plant in Union City, Indiana, Workhorse (Nasdaq: WKHS) is an American Industrial Technology company specializing in electrification, high-voltage systems integration, mobility platforms, ruggedized mobile platform manufacturing, distributed energy systems, and deployable industrial infrastructure. We manufacture durable, reliable and high-performing vehicles and infrastructure for mission-critical applications deployed in the world’s most demanding operating environments. More information is available at[www.workhorse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ukpv-8CdowuNIx7fId99lKI5x4k75bPjiZSsXaRZ4eLtwY0NQbU2gZHb8xiubNny-vX3pZYQbm68qq6GXIhCczrGD2A2CS8ORU1woUK3W0s=) .
